title: AXI Different-ID Read Response Completion
description: Two accepted AXI read bursts use different IDs. The ID 2 response can finish before ID 1 while beats within each burst and applicable same-ID responses retain their required order.

phases.name: Address
phases.description: The manager and subordinate accept AR for ID 1.

phases.name: Data
phases.description: Accepted R beats for ID 1 remain in burst beat order.

phases.name: Response
phases.description: The accepted RLAST beat retires the ID 1 read burst.

phases.name: Address
phases.description: The manager and subordinate accept AR for different ID 2.

phases.name: Data
phases.description: The single R beat for ID 2 carries RLAST.

phases.name: Response
phases.description: The accepted ID 2 RLAST retires before ID 1; this different-ID order is legal, not mandatory.
